scorecard.venue: Dr. Y.S. Rajasekhara Reddy ACA-VDCA Cricket Stadium

batting.name: S Dhawan
batting.dismissal: c J Botha b AD Russell

batting.name: DA Warner
batting.dismissal: c RV Uthappa b M Morkel

batting.name: RS Bopara
batting.dismissal: c J Botha b M Morkel

batting.name: RV Uthappa
batting.dismissal: c P Kumar b MC Henriques

batting.name: AD Russell
batting.dismissal: c DW Steyn b RS Bopara

batting.name: YK Pathan
batting.dismissal: c KV Sharma b B Kumar

balls.text: neatly done by Yadav, batsman is backing away to leg, he bowls it back of a length wide outside off, comfortably inside the marker, no way Rahul is reaching that
full toss on the pad, flicked away nicely but he has picked out the man at square leg
thick outside edge flies past a diving keeper for four as he heaves at a pitched up ball outside off
high full toss swung high over midwicket, long on runs in to his right to take it, but replays show that is just above waist height, and it is a no-ball
just short of Chawla at extra cover as Rahul smears a pitched up ball, there is confusion between the batsmen, and the result is they return to their ends after meeting in the middle

Yadav responds with a yorker that uproots off stump, Ojha was making room again but could not get the bat down in time, they check for the no-ball, it is a really tight one, Yadav probably had a few millimetres behind the line
Ojha manages maximum first ball of the last over, a length ball on middle and leg, Ojha clears front leg and clobbers it over wide long on
low full toss on the pad, Henriques stabs it in front of square for a couple
and now a sharp bouncer, what a first and only over from Russell, there is an appeal for caught behind, but Henriques was in no position to connect on a weak hook, this is off the shoulder
beaten with a short of a length ball that comes in a bit, he tried to force it square on the leg side but it was through him in a flash
quite full now, and Dhawan has drilled it straight to the man at long on, how much has he hurt Sunrisers' chances?
beaten on the pull now, acceleration just hasn't come for Dhawan and Sunrisers, this was quite pacy from Russell
Dhawan with the scoop over short fine leg, walks outside off, gets a full delivery he can get under and twirls it out of the reach of Morkel in the circle
shortish on the pad, he goes for a big pull but isn;t able to time yet again, will reach his fifty though
back of a length, cutting in from outside off, guided to point
Ojha shows off his timing again, this is skiddy, fast and short on the pad, he is on one leg as he swats it over the long leg boundary
that cuts in sharply from just back of a length, and Ojha is cramped and beaten on the inside edge
appeal for catch down the leg side but umpire Kulkarni says no, replays show he is right, the length ball has gone off the pad as Ojha missed the flick
has some width but not the pace for the cut, chops it to point
shot! this man has some timing, driven on the up, calmly tackling the extra bounce Morkel gets, past extra cover and easily beating the sweeper
now he tries to scoop it to fine leg, but Morkel follows him with a low full toss as he moves outside off, and Dhawan adjusts sharply to open the face and guide it to third man
slow again, from short of a length, Dhawan is completely done in on the attempted pull
gives him a slowish bouncer as Dhawan backs away to leg, Dhawan is in the air as he tries to upper cut, but cannot reach it, that was a wide for height, not given
back of a length ball climbing outside off, steered to third man
catching practice for extra cover and Morkel is the man again, Bopara has squeezed a full one straight to the man
short third man's dive is futile, Dhawan picks up four off the last ball of the over with a delicate reverse paddle from around the line of middle
down the track, has to stop as Narine slows and shortens it outside leg, Dhawan still picks up two with a tuck through square
opens the face on the straighter one and guides it to short third man
gets the sweep nicely past short fine leg, but deep square puts in a run and a slide to save a run, good running too to get the third
now he defends solidly off the front foot
straighter one, Dhawan did not seem to pick it as he opened up in the crease, is cramped and forces it back to the bowler
walks to off stump before the ball is delivered, it comes across from back of a length, he dabs it to third man
slowly rises from a shorter length, Bopara rides the bounce and runs it towards third man
reaches for a widish length ball and softly pushes it to point
Dhawan still can't time his strokes, gets too far across and mishits a cut to the sweeper now

gone this time, Morkel's preferred back of a length doing it, Warner did not seem to be sure about the pull as he took it from outside off, awkwardly top-edged it behind square on leg, Uthappa got under it safely

it almost appeared as if he was withdrawing from this delivery as he walked way outside leg even before it had been delivered, Morkel bowled it full, Warner reached it with a stretch and sliced it over point, almost goes for a six
was the straighter one on leg, Warner backed away and tried to force it, it goes square on off
some turn on this shortish ball, Dhawan pulls it through midwicket
flat into the pad, worked through midwicket
so he goes conventional slog-sweeping, easily gets underneath a flat and quick one and blasts it over wide long on
does not succeed on the switch hit attempt number three, tries a big slog sweep but it almost trickles on to his stumps
hit on the pad with a delivery slanted in from a length
tries to drill this full and widish one, misses, and it beats the keeper too

sees him making room outside leg, Botha follows his man, angles in a full toss, Warner cracks it down the ground, Morkel has misjudged the chance at long on, he's come in initially, then realised the ball is clearing him to his right, but it is too late by then, it has bounced just inside the rope in the end
a flighted yorker almost, on the pad, Warner gets them out of the way and flicks it square
leaves the crease again, Botha slows it up, Dhawan taps it in front of square leg
down the track but ends up pushing straight to extra cover
pushed down to long off
tries the reverse paddle now, the edge has hit the keeper's leg and gone really fine, long chase that, a chance technically
Dhawan gets a connection now, fullish around leg stump, he bends and picks up the slog sweep cleanly, way into the stands
shorter, and pummelled down the ground to long on
Warner changes stance second time and sweeps a slanted delivery violently over short fine leg, has picked up boundaries both times he's switched grips
tossed up full delivery worked with the spin to long on
and again, Warner has the space to cut square for an easy couple of runs
bouncing but providing width, Warner cuts it through point for two more
fuller ball hit hard and straight back to the bowler
clears wide long on in the end, Narine goes shortish again and Warner heaves it over midwicket, hasn't middled it but it has gone just over the man in the deep
flat-batted through extra cover, Suryakumar Yadav fumbles running across from long off and they take two
starts off stump and spins away wide, Warner reaches it and slams it past extra cover's dive, sweeper reaches it
Dhawan finally gets one away, gets this pitched up ball on the pad, and flicks it over the man at square leg, fine leg was up too and there is no stopping this one
back of a length and tucking him up on middle and leg, Dhawan manages an inside edge on to pad
fuller length now, Warner cannot get under it and forces it along the ground to long off
this will go, and also take Warner to his fifty, short outside off from Umesh, Warner jumps and cuts hard in the air, that flies several metres beyond square third man boundary
shortish and pulled hard through midwicket off the front foot, Pandey puts in a good sprint in the deep and dives to his left to prevent the boundary
Warner skips to the leg side and charges out first ball of the over, Umesh keeps it full and outside off, Warner misses
off stump line, worked down the ground, Pathan moves to his left but fails to prevent the single
comes down the track, Pathan shortens it, Dhawan stops and can only punch it to long off for one
length ball pushed off the front foot to long off
nudged behind square leg for one more
slants it in quicker now, it is worked off the pad through midwicket
too full on the stumps, Warner has no problems in getting under it after making some room and lofts it cleanly over the bowler
back of a length, middle and leg line, turned from the crease to deep midwicket
slowish and just outside leg stump, Warner stabs it through midwicket, enough time to come back for the second
slows it down considerably this time, Dhawan can only guide it square for a single
leg sidish with the line now and Warner forces it to deep midwicket off his pads
tries to go through the off side off this short of a length ball but extra cover runs to his left to stop it
short of a length, not much zip, but the line is around middle, Dhawan stays beside the line and taps it square on off
slows it up and gets it to hold and turn a bit, Dhawan adjusts to run it to backward point
stays back to a fuller one and flays it through the off side, there is a sweeper on the boundary
poor again from Yusuf, short and wide outside off, Warner cranks up and forces it past extra cover, could have stopped it with a better effort
stays in the crease and square-drives a length ball, cannot beat point
drags it short first up, gets some bounce, which is probably why Dhawan cannot place the pull past deep midwicket
worked to deep midwicket for a single
tries to pull but cannot get hold of a quicker one, it goes in the region of mid on
when conventional does not work, Warner changes his stance and grip to a shortish one and pulls it flat over square leg, or the former point position
comes out and has a go, but cannot get under it and mishits to mid on
pushed through quicker and slides in from wide of the crease, Warner is done in by the change of pace, is hit on the pad
tossed up on off stump, tapped square on the off side
spin and bounce from leg stump, Warner can only tap it on to the pitch
fuller, Warner goes back, tries to work it in front of square, bowler runs forward and denies him
short again, even though there is some turn, Warner has all the time to open up and put it away with a pull to deep midwicket
flatter one punched off the back foot to the sweeper
turning from outside leg into the pad, rolls away fine
plenty of turn right away, from around the line of off, tosses it up, Warner looks to defend, finds himself nowhere near the line, beaten by miles
stays beside the line to one rising and cramping him on middle, and dabs it behind point
Warner creates some space for himself outside leg stump, and blasts this short of a length ball flat over extra cover, he's struck it so hard that it almost carries all the way
right on off stump with one slanted across Dhawan, who pushes it to the right of extra cover for a single
pushes this length ball on the up, without timing, to extra cover
similar line just outside off, but a fuller length, and Dhawan cannot guide it past backward point
he's timed this alright, back of a length, quick and angled across the left-hander close to off, and Dhawan punches it in a flash past backward point
overpitched flighted ball outside off, Dhawan squeezes the drive past extra cover, hasn't timed it again, there is a man in the deep
bowled flatter and fuller into the pad, Warner takes another single in front of square
moves across to a length ball on middle and leg, tucks it to square leg for one
fired in to the pad, worked to short fine
Warner down the track, moving quite some way inside the line of one on off and lifts it cleanly with the turn over extra cover
tossed up slowly on off stump, pushed quietly off the front foot behind point, the throw from Yusuf is wayward and a run is gifted
Dhawan pushes a length ball on the up without timing, and picks up a single in front of mid off
absolutely no room with a skidding back of a length ball on middle, Warner opens the face and guides it to cover
Morkel goes fuller now, Warner is not really forward, and his drive is straight to mid on
another back of a length ball, but Warner uses the line on the pad, hops in the crease and swats it behind square, too quick for the man at fine leg
thick inside edge behind square leg now as Dhawan pushes at a short of a length ball
Morkel finds some bounce right away into the batsman's body, Warner hops and jabs it square for a tight single
tidy start from Botha, bowls it fuller into Warner's pads, Warner reacts a touch late but is able to tap it to midwicket
slower this time, bit of air again, around off stump line, Warner defends
this is flat and quicker, Warner makes some room and slaps it hard, but Pandey dives to stop it at extra cover, saved a few runs there
nicely bowled, some flight on this fullish ball on off, Warner well forward to smother it
straightening a tad on middle and leg, Dhawan goes back and works it to midwicket for a single
slanted in too much this time and it slips down the leg side
angled in to the pad from round the wicket, some bounce there for Botha, Dhawan fails to tuck it away
job done, Bhuvneshwar lets them have a length ball finally, it is pulled high but fails to clear the field, also falls short of deep midwicket
deep midwicket bends to pick up another one that rolls along the ground, they just have not been able to get the measure of these low full tosses
wide full toss, he jumps down the track and slices it past a diving backward point, Sunrisers will be fine with that
another low full toss, another heave, another single to long on, the crowd roars in approval
wide full toss, Pathan cracks it straight to extra cover, captain Warner roars
hits out at a full toss, deep midwicket is in the way, only a single
low full toss on the stumps, carted to deep midwicket, Dhawan loses the ball as he tries to throw it back quickly
slower length ball outside off now after those yorkers, Pathan slogs and misses
very full on the pads, swung away to deep square leg, they push for the second, make it
yet another yorker around off, this is terrific stuff, Pandey jabs it to point
PK sees Pandey moving to leg, follows him with a yorker, Pandey decides to save his feet, gets right leg out of the way, that is all he manages
slogged along the ground to wide long on, it slips through Steyn's hands, but Henriques is around right behind the fast bowler to save the boundary
lovely delivery, batsman moves across early in the crease, Bhuvneshwar hurls in a yorker just outside off, inside edge rolls to the keeper
Bhuvneshwar sticking to full tosses, Pathan cannot get much elevation on this, on a few bounces to long on
full toss on the stumps, another heave attempted, only a single to deep square leg
another low full toss, slammed straight down to long off
very low full toss outside off, Yusuf cannot connect as he brings the bat down late
down the track, takes it on the full, but only hammers it along the ground to long on
length ball but there is no pace for Pandey, and he drags a pull slowly through midwicket
Russell has failed to clear long on, seemed as if he had got more than enough on this full one as he sent it climbing into the sky, but it came down in Steyn's hands, and he is not dropping it
short of a length ball, and Russell latches on, clears front leg and crashes it between deep midwicket and deep square leg
gets the yorker in on off stump, Russell digs it out
now a misfield from Bhuvneshwar after a steer at short third man, they think about the second, but Russell dives back just in time
opens the face and runs a length ball to short third man
length ball nudged square off the pad
much flatter hit this time but same result, clears the deep midwicket boundary, Russell showing why he was promoted
can get under this, and slams it into the giant screen, was fullish on off, and he was instantly down on one knee to power it away
was winding up, but this was flat and slanted in to middle and leg, and he adjusted to defend
leaves the crease but is not close to the pitch and forces it to long on
tossed up slowly and turning away, guided to backward point, they wont get the single
bouncing good length ball outside off, he checks his push to point for a quick single
nicely done, Steyn with a low full toss outside off, Pandey calmly glides it to the square third man rope
gets this away, heaves another short of a length ball on off to the deep midwicket boundary
tries to cut even as he is backing away but this short of a length ball bounces over his attempt
backs away to leg, Steyn slants in a low full toss on leg stump, he heaves it to midwicket
watchfully pushes a pacy good length ball through point
beaten, Henriques floats it up outside off, lures him into a loose drive and gets it to move away
they finally take a catch, Uthappa did well to move across, lean forward and flick this full delivery from around off, but straight into the hands of short fine leg
slower and fuller outside off, he stretches and glides it past cover, sweeper tidies up
Pandey has properly clobbered this over deep midwicket, short and sitting up from Henriques, and Pandey gives it what it deseves
wanted to go after this pitched up ball and had made some room but could not get under it, squeezed it to extra cover
escapes with a single, the line was tighter but it was short again but Uthappa pulls on the bounce to deep midwicket
starts with a short and wide ball that moves further away
flat and quick on the stumps, he backs away and cuts hard, for a single to the sweeper
Uthappa has sent Pandey sprawling on the ground as he smacks a full delivery right on to the left pad flap
flatter one straightens on middle and leg, worked away to deep midwicket
launches a pitched up ball down the ground, couple of bounces to long on
full delivery clipped through midwicket, non-striker has to hurry back for the second as the throw comes in
big inswinger arrives near the boots, and Pandey has to jam bat down to keep it out again
moving in to the blockhole, Pandey digs it out
PK continues to deal in full tosses, but he sends Gambhir back with this one, it straightens late on the left hander, Gambhir wants to hoick it, only inside-edges into the stumps
could have been four more, had Uthappa not driven another full toss straight into the non-striker's stumps
this swung in full and quite late, but Uthappa got the bat down in time and flicked it behind square, four more
and is welcomed with a big six over midwicket, Uthappa creates momentum with a step down the track, lifts back leg and sends the slanted length ball soaring
wants to mow this back of a length ball through midwicket but cannot connect
bangs it in short, leg sidish, but over Gambhir's back as he ducks
a thick inside edge as Uthappa pushes at an incoming length ball on off, short fine leg stops it with a dive
Gambhir had taken a start as Uthappa drove in the air, mid on took it on the bounce but his throw missed, Gambhir would have probably been back anyway
and after the drop, Uthappa flicks so well off his pads that it clears Karn Sharma at deep square leg
another one dropped, Praveen Kumar this time at third man, Gambhir slashed hard, PK had it covered as it dipped, he bent and cupped his hands to take it, and it popped out
picks this length ball in the air off the pads, but there is a man at deep square leg
solid straight push into the pitch, bounces over the bowler, who puts a hand out and takes pace off it
gets away with a length ball down the leg side, Gambhir misses as he tries to force it fine
does not get hold of the cover drive and it is stopped in the ring with a slide
good length delivery slanted in and Uthappa takes a step across to clip it superbly through midwicket
down the track but only gets an under edge as he heaves, away to deep square leg
straightening on the right hander as it is pitched up, Uthappa carefully pats it down the track, bowler cannot stop it with a dive

Steyn slants a 145.1 kph length ball past Gambhir, who is beaten on another massive attempted drive, ball curls away as it nears the keeper, who appeals for the catch, Steyn joins in quite late, just in case
with two slips waiting, Uthappa tries to run a short of a length ball to third man, on the bounce and parried away by second slip
tries a big drive to a length ball just outside off, thick edge races to third man
dropped by second slip, Uthappa pokes at a widish back of a length ball leaving him, it is going close to Dhawan's right at first slip, but Rahul decides it is his catch, and spills it
leading edge flies past point as Uthappa looks to clip a rising length ball from middle, stopped just inside the rope
starts with a good length outswinger, Uthappa confidently forward but his push finds point
